list: The official 55 trophies, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles on 2026-11-18 (the two agree on every name, description and grade). Names and descriptions are shown as PlayStation publishes them; every guide below is written for this entry, in our own words, and names its source beside it.
sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles. Missable warning: Output Lag and PowerPyx. All other guidance: our own advice built from the official descriptions.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is nothing to do for it directly. Follow the roadmap in order: story first, then side strands and activities, then collectibles, and finish the money and 100% cleanup last.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.guide: Play through the opening mission Gone Fishing and see it to its end. It is the first story mission, so this is one of the earliest trophies you will earn and it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Before you leave the chapter, do the balcony meditation with Lucia at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude) and keep a manual save from the start of the chapter, since there is no mission replay.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); missable note: Output Lag + PowerPyx

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Once both Jason and Lucia are playable, partner trophies and two-character activities open up, so start working on those alongside the story from here.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. Keep rotating your manual saves at the start of each chapter as a safety net, and pick up any stranger strands that appear as you travel.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. By now most of the map and most side content should be open, so clear any stranger strands and side missions you have been putting off before pushing on.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. Make a manual save just before it, and keep a separate save from the start of the final chapter, since there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); no-replay note: Output Lag + PowerPyx

trophies.guide: Play the mission Breakfast Run to the end. It is a Chapter 1 story mission, so it comes naturally while working through the story and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.guide: Play the mission The Cartel Heist to the end. Stock up on armour and ammo beforehand, since heist missions tend to be long and combat-heavy.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.guide: Play the mission Child's Play to the end. It is a story mission, so it unlocks in order as you progress and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.guide: Play the mission Headliners to the end. It is a story mission, so it unlocks in order as you progress and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.guide: Play the mission VCIA Takedown to the end. It is a story mission, so it unlocks in order as you progress and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.guide: Play the mission Operation Savage Glory to the end. Bring your best weapons and armour, since it is one of the heavier combat missions in the later chapters.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion, tracked in the game's Progress menu. That means the story, stranger strands, collectibles, activities and exploration all done, so treat this as the last gold before the platinum and check the in-game checklist for whatever is left.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts: jumps, near misses, drifts, airtime and similar driving feats. They add up naturally across a full playthrough, so just drive hard and check the counter in the Progress menu; farm jumps on a fast car if you are short at the end.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types at least once: fishing, drone racing, arcade games, bowling, the shooting range, races and the rest. Any activity icon on the map counts, so sample one of each as you meet them rather than leaving them all to the end.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Work through them weapon by weapon, learn each challenge's target pattern, and retry the ones you miss: gold is a score bar, not a one-shot pass, so a steady aim beats rushing.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); count 42 from PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Learn each course's corners and boost gates, and retry a location until the win lands; the counter tracks each location separately.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across the game's race types. Vary the events rather than repeating one race, since only distinct races count, and pick a car suited to each event.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Challenge Cal to a fishing contest and out-fish him. Use the best rod and bait you can get, watch the line tension, and retry if he wins: the challenge is repeatable, so losing costs nothing but time.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game to completion. Pick the shortest or easiest cabinet you find and play it through; you do not need a high score, just a finished game.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand through to its last mission. Start his strand as soon as it appears and follow it whenever new missions show up, so it is done before the story ends.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand through to its last mission. Start his strand as soon as it appears and follow it whenever new missions show up, so it is done before the story ends.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand through to its last mission. Start his strand as soon as it appears and follow it whenever new missions show up, so it is done before the story ends.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers appear as icons on the map; start each strand when you meet it and return whenever new missions appear, since some strands only advance as the story moves on.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand through to its last mission. Start his strand as soon as it appears and follow it whenever new missions show up, so it is done before the story ends.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand through to its last mission. Start his strand as soon as it appears and follow it whenever new missions show up, so it is done before the story ends.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. Spots show as purple icons when you are close, and meditating at a spot with both Jason and Lucia counts twice. Track progress under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. THE MISSABLE ONE: in Chapter 1, the morning after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house, follow her to the balcony and accept her meditation. It is gone once Chapter 1 ends and there is no mission replay, so do it in Chapter 1 and keep a Chapter 1 manual save until the trophy pops. It is not yet confirmed whether this one is strictly required, so do it anyway to be safe.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.source: Output Lag + PowerPyx (Chapter 1 balcony meditation, no mission replay); count 18 from PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take on Bret's hunt and bring down the unique animal he asks for. Track it with the hunting clues and your weapon of choice, and take the shot cleanly when it shows itself.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida, so pick up every card you spot while exploring and use the in-game collection tracker to see which sets are still short.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations. The counter counts distinct places, so spread it out as you explore rather than repeating one spot, and check the Progress menu to see how many are left.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges of any kind. Challenges stack up across driving, combat, exploration and activities, so just keep playing and ticking them off; check the challenge list to target the ones nearest done.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the heat drops. Use fast cars, alleys and water to break the chase, and do not get caught mid-escape.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level. Pick three shops close together, plan a fast route between them, and keep moving: the streak breaks if the wanted level clears, so do not let the heat drop between robberies.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Every new vehicle you get into or drive counts, so try every car, bike, boat and truck you see while exploring; the discovery tracker shows what you have found.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: In one single use of Combat Focus, take down 5 enemies. Wait for a fight with a crowd of enemies close together, trigger Combat Focus, and chain your shots before it runs out; a packed street fight is the easiest place to get all five.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, leave in a way no timetable allows: take an aircraft and get out of the airport area without following the usual route. Expect a wanted level, so have an escape plan ready before you try.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino tank and stir up trouble with it. Steal or find a Rhino, then cause chaos while riding it out; the trophy is about doing something bold in the tank, so commit to the run once you have one.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without any detection. Go in quiet, avoid cameras and guards, grab the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm; if you are spotted, back out and try again.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Plan each robbery with a getaway car and route ready, since the escape is part of the trophy, and repeat until all five are done.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush one on the road, stop it, take the cash and get clear before the police close in; a fast getaway car parked nearby makes the escape easy.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive, walk and fly into every corner of the map, including the outlying counties, and watch the area counter in the Progress menu to find the regions you have not visited yet.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); count 52 from PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Find each gang's operation on the map, hit it and get out; work through the gangs one by one and track which ones you have already robbed.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Head to Ocean Beach, find a spot with a view of the water, and enjoy a cocktail there. It is a quiet moment trophy, so take it slow and enjoy the scenery.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive into a vehicle showroom and smash your way out through the front in classic style. Pick a sturdy car, build speed inside, and burst through the glass; expect a wanted level, so leave fast.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a proper follow-through: play a full game and finish your throws cleanly. It is a relaxed activity trophy, so just play it through.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.guide: Do something together as a partnership that wins a crowd: play through a partner moment that draws a reaction from the people around you. It unlocks while playing the story with your partner, so keep doing duo activities.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.guide: Make choices across the game until the hidden count reaches 500. Choices happen in missions, conversations and free roam, so play naturally and pick options whenever the game offers them; the count builds up over a full playthrough.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); count 500 from PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Succeed at something on your second try. Fail an attempt at a challenge or activity, then go straight back and pass it: the trophy is about the retry, so pick something you can fail and pass quickly.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.guide: Witness something strange in Leonida. Keep your eyes open while exploring: odd events, encounters and sights are scattered across the state, and this one pops when you stumble into one of them.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by: attack with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and bowl them over. Pick a slow-moving target on a quiet street and line the swing up as you pass.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Keep collecting marked bills from robberies and heists, pass them through your laundering contacts, and watch the total climb; it adds up across the whole playthrough.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in total. Weapons, clothes, cars and upgrades all count, so buy what you need as you go and the total will climb; check the spending tracker to see how close you are.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Each one costs money, so save up during the story and buy them as you can afford them; owning garages also gives you somewhere to store your best cars.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); count 8 from PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find different vehicles, open the app and register each one; variety counts, so register every new vehicle you drive rather than the same one twice.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); count 10 from PSNProfiles
